Text: Whoa! Look, <NAME>, we’re outside.
Let’s take a look down from the observation deck.

Whoa, we’re so high up!
The Mikasa’s huge!
The Mikasa’s over 1000 meters tall, you know.

Huh…
It sure is huge, alright.
Gotta be careful not to fall.

1000 meters?!
Eek!
I’ll be extra careful not to fall!

Heehee…
I think you ought to be fine…
But do be careful not to drop anything from up here.
There’s a park down there, so if anything here falls, it might hit someone.

… Huh?!
It’s not here… It’s gone!
I could’ve sworn it was here…
What’s wrong, Sakura?

U-Um… Well…
It seems I’ve, uh…
Dropped something…
Huh? Didn’t you just tell me to be careful not to drop anything?

No, not like that.
I lost something on the way here.
It was, um, my wallet…
Huh? Your wallet?!

Ugah!
What’s this pink thing?

Ah! !
That demon’s got my wallet!

That pink wallet’s mine!
Give it back!

Ugah? This thing?
It’s mine!
Finders keepers!
If you want it, then fight me for it, ugah!
Thank goodness I got my precious wallet back…
That’s great, Sakura…
But shouldn’t you have left something that important back at the Theater?

Well, sure, but…
This wallet is very special to me.
My father gave it to me.
I feel safer when I have it with me, like my father is watching over me…
So it’s a protective charm of sorts, huh?
Heehee, that’s right.
